Accounts Payable Specialist - UK Shift

Accounting Remote - India

Apply

Description

Position at Ziff Davis

The Opportunity: 

We are looking for a detail-oriented and collaborative Accounts Payable Specialist to join our Finance team. In this role, you will manage end-to-end invoice processing, vendor onboarding and relations, payment disbursements, and month-end close support across multiple business units and subsidiaries.

Key Responsibilities

  • Invoice Processing & Allocation: Review, code, and enter invoices into Oracle Fusion accurately; allocate shared expenses across relevant business units, departments, and subsidiaries.
  • Approval & Workflow Management: Partner across departments (Engineering, Sales, Operations, Technology, Legal) to route invoices, secure timely approvals, and resolve billing discrepancies.
  • Payment Execution: Prepare and process electronic funds transfers (EFT/ACH), wire transfers, and check runs, prioritizing payments to optimize cash discounts and adhere to vendor terms.
  • Vendor Onboarding & Compliance: Manage vendor setup, collect and validate required banking credentials, maintain tax documentation (W-9s, W-8BENs), and support annual 1099 filings.
  • Account Reconciliation: Reconcile monthly vendor statements and accounts payable aging schedules; research and resolve past-due balances and vendor inquiries.
  • Month-End Close Support: Assist with the monthly accrual process, reconcile AP subledgers with general ledger accounts, and coordinate with the treasury team on bank reconciliations.
  • Expense Reporting: Audit employee expense reports against corporate travel and entertainment policies to ensure compliance and proper documentation.
  • Process Improvement: Maintain audit-ready documentation in alignment with internal controls (SOX) and support initiatives to streamline AP workflows using automation and AI tools.

Qualifications

Required: 

  • 3+ years of accounts payable or general corporate accounting experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of full-cycle AP, vendor tax documentation (W-9, W-8BEN, 1099), and standard internal controls.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, data formatting).
  • Experience with multi-entity/subsidiary expense allocations and intercompany transactions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interface diplomatically across all departments.

Preferred: 

  • Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion (or comparable enterprise ERP systems like SAP or NetSuite).
  • Experience supporting foreign currency/international payments and operating within a Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliant environment.
  • Familiarity with modern AP automation tools and a willingness to explore AI-assisted financial workflows
